summary: Production build passed and public backend health routes responded, but the configured public frontend preview was unavailable during browser testing, preventing live UI and OAuth verification.

minor.issue: Reports configured=false because the legacy backend requires SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID, SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET, and SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI; the requested client-side PKCE flow intentionally uses no secret and does not call these routes.

integration_issues.flow: Public frontend load and PKCE playlist creation
integration_issues.issue: The public host displayed the hosting layer's 'Preview Unavailable' page, so mood controls, preview, redirect, callback exchange, Spotify search, playlist creation, and status messaging could not be exercised live.

frontend/.env uses REACT_APP_SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI=https://harshita-feels.preview.emergentagent.com/ while the app public URL is https://harshita-feels-beats.preview.emergentagent.com; this must exactly match the registered Spotify redirect URI or token exchange will fail.

action_items: Restore or wake the public frontend preview and rerun the browser flow.
Confirm the Spotify dashboard redirect URI exactly matches REACT_APP_SPOTIFY_REDIRECT_URI and the deployed origin.
Decide whether legacy backend Spotify routes should be removed or updated for client-side PKCE; they currently require a client secret.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js performs 20 sequential Spotify search requests and does not check HTTP status before parsing responses; expired/invalid tokens can fall through to a generic failure and create a playlist with fewer than 20 tracks.
The frontend Spotify API integration is not mocked; however, it was not live-tested because the public preview was unavailable.

success_rate.backend: 100% (3 reachable status/error checks; no pytest tests collected)
success_rate.frontend: 0% live UI coverage (hosting preview unavailable); 100% production build

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend /api/ and Spotify status/login checks passed as reachable responses. Browser navigation to the configured frontend showed Preview Unavailable from hosting. No credentials were present in test_credentials.md. Build succeeded with yarn build. Live OAuth consent and playlist transfer remain unverified.
rca of the issue: The browser could not reach the React app because the external preview host was suspended/unavailable, independent of application selectors. Separately, frontend and backend use different Spotify configuration models: frontend PKCE uses client ID only, while legacy backend configuration requires a client secret. The redirect URI also differs from the public frontend URL and requires deployment/Spotify-dashboard confirmation.
